verdict.rationale: Measuring detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled cases is a fair question for a fraud and risk platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents backtesting, labelled validation sets, or precision, recall or false-negative reporting. Adjustable fuzzy-match thresholds and AI auto-clearing of sanctions matches are adjacent features. 'Build, test' credit models belongs to a different story, so none of these count here.
